name: JSW Energy Ltd
title: JSW Energy Ltd - 533148 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity 13.45 GW after 2.6 GW added in FY26, with ~3 GW RE additions guided for FY27 and 14 GW under construction; Q4 EBITDA up 72% YoY to ₹2,602 crore, but commissioning delays and curtailment remain the swing factor.

utilisation.quote: our overall thermal portfolio maintained a healthy PLF of 78% for the quarter and 73% for the full year

capex.quote: This Fiscal year, we are looking to add about 3 GW capacity and a capex spent of around Rs 20,000 Crores for the year.

triggers.label: FY27 RE additions ~3 GW
triggers.quote: approximately close to about 3 GW of capacity additions will happen in FY27

triggers.label: Merchant premium 20%+ maintained
triggers.quote: we will definitely maintain at least minimum 20% premium and we are continuing with that

triggers.label: Projects deliberately delayed for connectivity
triggers.quote: we have deliberately delayed the execution and investment in these projects because the availability of the allotted connectivity is getting delayed

triggers.label: No unsigned PPA movement seen
triggers.quote: we are not seeing any significant movement on the signing of the PPAs for the unsigned capacities

guidance.quote: approximately close to about 3 GW of capacity additions will happen in FY27
a capex spent of around Rs 20,000 Crores for the year
please assume 2700 as our base case EBITDA
deleveraging on a path towards our 2030 Net Debt to EBITDA target of approximately 5 to 5.5x
we expect a total impact which we have budgeted in our plan is between 1.5% – 2%

red_flags.label: Commissioning delays tied to connectivity
red_flags.quote: we have deliberately delayed the execution and investment in these projects because the availability of the allotted connectivity is getting delayed

red_flags.label: Net debt rising; leverage ~5.2x
red_flags.quote: our Net Debt to EBITDA stands at approximately 5.2x

evasions.quote: Merchant? What we will see, maybe we will divide and we will come back.
It is varying. Again, if you are at Tier 1, Tier 2, very difficult to give a number.
Maybe next time, we will definitely like to share on that.
